resale_co.name: Resale / Land Use Certificate (Transfer of Title Certificate)
resale_co.issued_by: City of Margate City Department of Building Inspection (Construction Code Official)
requirements: Smoke alarms on each level, in every bedroom and outside each sleeping area within 10 feet of doorways
10-year sealed lithium battery smoke alarms (since January 1, 2019); existing AC-powered alarms accepted, do not remove
Carbon monoxide alarms on each level and outside sleeping areas
GFCI outlets at kitchen and bathroom counters, within 6 feet of a utility sink or wet bar, and in garages and outdoors
Portable fire extinguisher (2A-10B:C, 10 lb max) within 10 feet of the kitchen, on its bracket, top no higher than 5 feet, with the manual left for the new occupant (checklist still lists it)
No open permits (checked by the office)
No dwelling can be occupied until the certificate is issued

fees.label: Resale/Land Use Certificate application
fees.quote: 1) Submit this application along with the $60.00 fee payable to the City of Margate.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Resale/Land Use Certificate Application (Title Transfers) with seller, agent and buyer details, the person to meet the inspector and the settlement date, and submit it with the $60.00 fee payable to the City of Margate (check, cash or card) to the Department of Building Inspection, 9001 Winchester Avenue, Margate City, NJ 08402 (margate_inspection@margate-nj.com). Then coordinate the inspection with the Building Department. Attach the Boca form for demolition or rehab if the buyer plans either.

evidence.quote: Transfers of Title Certificates: To purchase or sell a property, a Land Use Certificate application must be completed before closing.
Certificate Required: Per City of Margate Code Chapter 161, no dwelling can be sold, rented, or transferred without a certificate issued by the Construction Code Official.
No dwelling can be occupied until the certificate is issued.
John Votta Housing/Zoning Inspector, Code Enforcement Officer 609-822-2605, ext. 126
RENTAL AND RESALE HOUSING INSPECTION REQUIREMENTS

resale_co.notes: Margate requires a Resale/Land Use Certificate from the Department of Building Inspection before a dwelling is sold or transferred (City Code Chapter 161, per the application). The application (August 2024) is still the one linked from the Rentals and Resales page. The page now links the inspection checklist as DocumentCenter 4587 ('Rental and Resale Inspection Requirements'), which could not be downloaded (connection reset); the same August 2024 checklist is still served at DocumentCenter 4755, which is cited. The 2025 fee schedule (revised May 2025) lists 'Certificate of Continued Occupancy: $168.00' among Uniform Construction Code fees; that line is not tied to the resale certificate, so it is not recorded as a resale fee. John Votta (Housing/Zoning Inspector, 609-822-2605 ext. 126) is another likely contact; Palma Shiles (Office Supervisor, ext. 117) is the page's main contact. Margate also requires a Rental License each time a tenant changes (rental program, not resale). The City code (ecode360 MA0562) could not be opened.

requirements: Smoke alarms on each level, in every bedroom and outside each sleeping area within 10 feet of doorways
10-year sealed lithium battery single-station smoke alarms since January 1, 2019; existing AC-powered alarms stay
Carbon monoxide alarms on each level and outside sleeping areas

Portable fire extinguisher 2A-10B:C, no more than 10 lb, within 10 feet of the kitchen in a path of egress, mounted on its bracket with the top no more than 5 feet above the floor; owner's manual left for the new occupant (form still lists it)

authorities.name: Margate City Department of Building Inspection (smoke detector compliance) / Margate City Fire Department (fire code enforcing agency)
authorities.how_to_apply: The smoke, CO and extinguisher items are checked in the Building Department's rental and resale housing inspection. No separate smoke/CO certificate application or fee was found online; ask the Department of Building Inspection (609-822-1974) whether the $60.00 Resale/Land Use Certificate covers it.

evidence.quote: All smoke alarms shall be installed as follows:
Approved listed and labeled type with a minimum rating of 2A-10B:C and no more than 10
LEAID: 0116-001 Margate City SMOKE DETECTOR COMPLIANCE Name: Margate City Code Enf

fire_cert.notes: DCA registry code F (Margate City Fire Department). The state fire directory (survey 5/26/2026) names Fire Chief Daniel Adams as Fire Official, with phone (609) 822-1974 (the Department of Building Inspection line) and email adams_dan@margate-nj.com, and shows 'Margate City Code Enf' in the smoke detector compliance block. The City's Rental and Resale Housing Inspection Requirements (August 2024) cover smoke alarms, CO alarms, GFCI outlets and a portable fire extinguisher, and the Building Department staff list includes a Fire Inspector, so the resale smoke/CO check appears to be done by the Building Department. The Fire Department page (Chief Daniel Adams, 609-822-5562, adams_dan@margate-nj.com) has no smoke certificate information. No separate smoke/CO certificate fee was found. The checklist still lists the fire extinguisher, which state law (P.L.2025, c.19) dropped from the sale certificate in February 2025.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: The resale application's office section records 'No Open Permits' or lists open permits and the date closed.

other_items.label: Boca form for demolition or rehab
other_items.detail: Attach the Boca Form for Demo or Boca Form for Rehab if the property will be demolished or rehabilitated.
